codex.entrypoint: entry_strategy=dynamic-resolve: AGENTS.override.md > AGENTS.md > any configured adapter.options.codex.project_doc_fallback_filenames, first match at the instance root wins (resolve_active_entrypoint()) - marker-merge into whichever one resolves, project-owned content below EIF:END preserved byte-for-byte. Was, until the active-entrypoint correctness round, hardcoded to always target AGENTS.md with only a WARN when an override shadowed it - a real defect (a dead write with no STOP), found and fixed before merge.

codex.adapter_switching: supported for both claude-code<->codex (scenarios 3-5, 18a/18b) and cursor<->codex (scenarios 27-30), both directions. Unlike Cursor (full-regen), switching away from codex or claude-code strips the EIF block but does not delete the file, since a marker-merge entrypoint's placeholder footer is never empty - verified explicitly in scenario 4. Switching AWAY from codex reads its actual prior entrypoint from the lock (not the static greenfield default), since the prior write may have gone to AGENTS.override.md rather than AGENTS.md.
codex.runtime_consumption_evidence: CONFIRMED for the CLI surface (Codex Cloud's global scope is not independently verified - it keeps its own separate environment/workspace configuration per the official docs, though the project-scope AGENTS.md content EIF manages is part of the repo itself and should behave identically there). Verified 2026-07-17 against `codex --version` (codex-cli 0.144.5) and the official docs, re-fetched during the active-entrypoint correctness round to confirm project_doc_fallback_filenames. A 2026-07-18 post-merge review found the first-pass description of project-root discovery and the size budget had never been checked against Codex's own PRIMARY source (only the secondary docs page) and was wrong on both: root discovery does not walk to the filesystem root when no `project_root_markers` marker exists anywhere (it inspects cwd alone), and `project_doc_max_bytes` truncates a file mid-content rather than skipping it whole - both fixed and re-verified against `github.com/openai/codex` commit `3a067484584861606ad842de5bc4ac735a865ddf`. Real runtime proof via `codex debug prompt-input` (no authentication required), repeated from the INSTALLED WHEEL (`eifctl init --adapter codex`) against disposable probe projects, including one run entirely against an isolated, empty `CODEX_HOME` (2026-07-18): confirmed the actual wheel-generated AGENTS.md is loaded; confirmed a same-directory AGENTS.override.md becomes the active target exactly as eif_verify_runtime.py's doctor predicts; confirmed a nested subdirectory's own AGENTS.md is appended after the root's content when cwd is inside it; confirmed a 40000-byte decoy parent AGENTS.md is never read when no root marker exists anywhere; confirmed the real truncation point at a lowered project_doc_max_bytes matches this adapter's own simulator byte-for-byte. See adapters/codex/README.md for the full evidence trail (sanitized - no raw probe output retained anywhere, any round).
